description_en: Queries the task list of site monitoring
description_zh: 查询站点监控的任务列表
name: DescribeTasks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site monitoring task. The ID uniquely identifies the task
parameters.help_zh: 站点监控的任务Id，任务的唯一标识
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the task. Valid values: 1 to 8. Each value represents a type as follows: 1: HTTP. 2: PING. 3: TCP. 4: UDP. 5: DNS. 6: SMTP. 7: POP3. 8: FTP
parameters.help_zh: 任务的类型，取值分别为1-8，各个值代表的如下 1.HTTP 2.PING 3.TCP 4.UDP 5.DNS 6.SMTP 7.POP3 8.FTP
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The keyword to search for. The keyword is used to perform a fuzzy match on the name and address of the monitoring site
parameters.help_zh: 要搜索的关键词，模糊查询监控监控点名称和地址
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示记录条数，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size
